The '''Commerce Guild corvette''' was a type of [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] used by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. Alongside [[Commerce Guild fleet patrol craft]], these corvettes were employed by the [[Escarte Guard/Legends|Escarte Guard]] to defend the Commerce Guild's [[Escarte/Legends|Escarte]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil" />
